title: Prompt library manifest
description: prompts/manifest.yaml in the Mermaide repository (Requirement 18): every prompt module with its version, owning agent, family variants, source, and license; the model families variants are chosen for; and the modules each agent's system prompt is built from, in order.

families.description: Model families, checked in order: the first one that matches a model picks its variants (R18.2). A model no family matches gets the base modules.

agents.description: Agent name to the modules its system prompt is built from, in order.

templates.description: Modules that are user-prompt templates rather than system-prompt parts: the editor's quick actions and "Ask Mermaide to fix" (R35.2, R35.3). A template belongs to * and may use {{placeholders}} the IDE fills in.

moduleId.description: The module's path under prompts/ without .md, e.g. workflows/spec-requirements.

models.description: Case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the model part of the model ID (after provider/), so a family's models are found at any provider (Bedrock, OpenRouter).

local.description: Matches a model the catalog marks local, or one whose provider runs on this machine.

version.description: Bumped on every change to the module or one of its variants; the header of each file says the same.

agent.description: The agent that owns the module, or * for a module shared by several agents.

source.description: Where the text comes from: written for Mermaide, or the upstream it's derived from (R18.4).

license.description: The module's SPDX license. Only licenses that allow reuse (R18.4).

variants.description: Families with their own copy of the module, at prompts/variants/<family>/<id>.md.
